channel.title: Blog Stories by Bhagyeshkumar Chokhawala
channel.description: Enterprise architecture, applied AI, modernization, and digital transformation stories.

item.title: Your Autoscaler Added More Servers. Why Did Customers Still See Errors?
item.description: Autoscaling can add instances and still leave customers facing slow requests and failed transactions. This story explains why scaling must account for when capacity becomes usable and how accepted work survives the transition.

item.title: Why enterprise scaling needs capacity-based math, a clock, and a transaction-safety model.
item.description: Extends capacity-based autoscaling with measured time-to-capacity, scaling-bridge controls, dependency limits, and transaction safeguards that prevent accepted work from being lost or duplicated.

item.title: The Future Enterprise Stack: Building Human-Centric Enterprises with AI Agents
item.description: Explores a human-directed, agent-executed enterprise stack in which people own intent, AI agents perform delegated work, and technology provides governed enablement and control.

item.title: Capability-Centric Enterprise Architecture for Business-Technology Alignment and AI Adoption
item.description: Presents an integrated view of business capability maps, technical capability maps, implementation models, traceability, and governed AI adoption.

item.title: Spec-Grounded Modernization: Leveraging AI Specification Kits for Brownfield Software Systems
item.description: Proposes architecture-aware modernization using recovered system context, structured requirements, AI-assisted specifications, planning, validation, and traceability.

item.title: From Hype to Strategy: Navigating AI Integration in the Modern Enterprise
item.description: Examines how enterprise architects can align AI strategy, organizational readiness, human-AI collaboration, architecture, and responsible governance.

item.title: Target Architecture
item.description: Explains target architecture as a future-state blueprint connecting objectives, capabilities, technology, governance, investment, and transition roadmaps.

item.title: Digital Transformation vs. Digitization vs. Digital Modernization: Key ROI Factors to Consider
item.description: Clarifies digitization, modernization, and transformation and discusses strategic fit, risk, cost, adoption, and ROI.
